meta.title: Braspaña Sabores · Brazilian kitchen in Vilanova i la Geltrú
meta.description: Pastel de feira, coxinha and Brazilian coffee in Vilanova i la Geltrú. Brazilian street food, made to order. Order on WhatsApp or by phone: 667 34 01 75.
meta.ogAlt: Braspaña Sabores, Brazilian kitchen in Vilanova i la Geltrú

hero.title: The taste of Brazil, close to home
hero.lede: Pastel de feira fried to order, chicken coxinha and Brazilian coffee. Brazilian street food in a corner of Vilanova, for a quick bite or a taste of home.

roast.title: Brazilian street food
roast.lead: What leaves the kitchen is what people ate on the streets of Brazil: pastry fried to order, generous fillings and proper coffee.

menu.title: What you will find
menu.lead: A short menu, focused on what they do well. It changes with the day and what is available.

pastel.name: Pastel de feira
pastel.note: The thin, crisp pastry of the Brazilian market, fried to order.

coxinha.name: Chicken coxinha
coxinha.note: Shaped like a drumstick, filled with shredded chicken.

caldo.name: Sugarcane juice
caldo.note: Freshly pressed sugarcane juice, sweet and cold.

bolo.name: Bolo de milho
bolo.note: Sweetcorn cake, soft and not too sweet.

cafe.name: Brazilian coffee
cafe.note: Strong coffee, the way it is drunk in Brazil.

yucca.name: Cassava coxinhac
yucca.note: The cassava version, for anyone who does not eat chicken.

menu.note: No prices on this page: ask on WhatsApp and we will tell you what is available today.

reviews.title: What people say after eating here
reviews.lead: Extracts from Google reviews, mostly from Brazilian customers who recognise the taste of home.

visit.title: How to get here
visit.lead: We are in Vilanova i la Geltrú. Message on WhatsApp and we will give you the exact address and what is on that day.

footer.legal: This page is an information sheet for the business. For orders and availability, please contact the shop directly.

cookies.text: We use technical cookies to remember your choice. If you accept, we also measure visits with Google Analytics and load the Google map.
